backend/main.mo: Main backend actor providing homepage content management, user profiles, generation history, access control, and site retirement state handling.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades the actor’s persisted state by adding a websiteState field defaulting to active.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based style sheet defining color tokens, theme variables, and dark mode overrides.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document loading the main React entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app configuring routing, theming, and retired-site gating for non-admin users.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileDialo: Dialog component allowing users to edit and save their profile name with validation and loading states.
frontend/src/components/GeneratedAssetCa: Reusable card component for previewing generated assets with optional download and loading overlay.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Provides a login/logout button using Internet Identity and clears React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Displays a dialog for new authenticated users to enter and save their name.
frontend/src/components/RequireAuth.tsx: Wraps protected content and prompts unauthenticated users to sign in.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Renders the site footer with branding and copyright text.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Renders the site header with branding, navigation, auth menu, and admin link logic.
frontend/src/components/ToolCard.tsx: Displays a card linking to a tool with icon, description, and call-to-action button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Checks whether the current caller is an admin using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useHomepageContent.ts: Fetches and updates homepage content using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides hooks for user profile, generation history, and related CRUD actions via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useWebsiteAdminAction: Provides admin-only actions like retiring/reactivating the site and purging data.
frontend/src/hooks/useWebsiteStatus.ts: Fetches the website's operational status from the backend.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining extensive light/dark theme variables plus retired-theme utilities and global typography styles.
frontend/src/lib/clientImageGen.ts: Generates a deterministic abstract image on a canvas from a prompt, then outputs it as a PNG blob and data URL.
frontend/src/lib/clientVideoGen.ts: Creates a short animated particle video based on a seeded prompt using canvas captureStream and returns a WebM blob.
frontend/src/lib/historyAssetStore.ts: IndexedDB wrapper for saving and retrieving generated asset blobs keyed by unique IDs.
frontend/src/lib/homepageDefaults.ts: Defines default homepage and branding content and provides a merge function to combine backend data with defaults.
frontend/src/lib/voiceover.ts: Wrapper around Web Speech API enabling speak, pause, resume, and stop for voiceover playback.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry point setting up QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering the App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminHomeEditor.tsx: Admin page allowing authenticated admins to edit homepage content and manage website retirement/reactivation.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Homepage displaying hero content and tool cards using merged backend/default homepage data.
frontend/src/pages/MyHistory.tsx: Displays the user's generation history with preview, re-edit, and delete actions, using hooks for data fetching and mutations.
frontend/src/pages/SiteRetired.tsx: Shows a retired-site notice with an optional message pulled from website status.
frontend/src/pages/TextToImage.tsx: Provides a text-to-image generator with prompt input, image generation, download, and history save/update support.
frontend/src/pages/TextToVideo.tsx: Implements text-to-video generation with prompt input, video preview, and history save or update features.
frontend/src/pages/TextToVoiceover.tsx: Generates speech from text with selectable voices, playback controls, and history save/update logic.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, writing, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS with custom color system, typography, animations, and plugins for theming and layout.
project_state.json: Defines project state showing the site-retirement feature set, pending backend requirements, and metadata for project cancellation.
